description: A mounted knight in a red cloak and chainmail raises a mace on a dark horse, in front of a stone fortification with its wooden gate doors thrown open. Smoke fills the dark sky with an orange glow on the left. Armoured soldiers with round shields, axes and spears crowd around him, and a helmeted man with an axe is in the lower right foreground. No visible text, border or frame; the painting runs edge to edge. No visible blood or gore.
